The primitive hexagonal cell and Z=1 are strongly supported: all 40 prominence-selected peaks are accounted for within 0.03 degrees, and refinement of indexed centers gives about 0.0014 degrees RMS. The submitted TaS2/NbS2 framework with tetrahedral Cu is chemically plausible, has sensible Ta-S, Nb-S, and Cu-S distances, and its 37 fitted integrated-reflection groups correlate at about 0.996. Importantly, the trajectory instantiated all A/B/C layer registries, refined the leading alternatives, and separately optimized the Ta/Nb layer exchange; the next registries and exchanged metal ordering were substantially worse, while the remaining B/C alternative is inversion-equivalent rather than a distinct structure. P3m1 follows from the recovered special-position stacking, and Z=1 plus the supplied stoichiometry supports the full occupancies. A comparable whole-pattern Rwp was not supplied and coordinate shifts of up to roughly 0.13 angstrom occur under alternate weighting, so the evidence is not a high-precision Rietveld determination, but these limitations do not expose an unresolved material discrete model or a scientifically motivated alternative likely to improve the candidate set.
